name: Change control: pinned releases, regression runs and sign-off before promotion
description: A model digest and program hash are pinned per release, and promotion is blocked without a regression run of exactly that release and a sign-off by the release role.
limits: Covers the agent's own release (program, models, packs). Infrastructure changes and upstream services are out of scope. Pair with change-impact replay (shio impact) to see which past decisions a release would flip before approving it.

hazards.title: A model or program change degrades decisions without anyone checking

controls.title: Releases pin the program and models
controls.requirement: A release pins the program by sha256 and every model by digest or exact version.

controls.title: Regression run of the exact release
controls.requirement: Promotion needs a regression run that evaluated exactly this release and met its gates.

controls.title: Role sign-off before promotion
controls.requirement: Promotion needs a sign-off of this release's hash by the release role, by someone other than its owner.
